text:
maya (Design): Quick thread about the trace viewer header + export UX. Sketch: https://figma.redwood/trace-header-compact. Two main asks: make correlation id actions discoverable on mobile, and fix export label mismatch.

jon (Product): Users keep asking why CSV column names don't match UI copy.

lee (Eng-runtime): Currently UI shows human labels; export uses keys. I can bundle a mapping table in the export modal.

tess (Accessibility): Also flag: the correlation id copy button is icon-only and not announced. Need aria-label and visible text in wide layouts.

maya (Design): Proposal: show "Correlation ID" label on wide screens, collapse to "Corr ID" on small screens but expose a tooltip and a "Copy ID" button.

abby (Eng-SRE): Add a quick "Open spans with this ID" action next to the header for faster triage.

lee (Eng-runtime): Will implement single-focus minimap nav (arrow keys) instead of hundreds of tab stops, and add an aria-live announcement for the focused span.

tess (Accessibility): Ensure live text includes the correlation id verbatim and that export modal uses semantic table markup.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: trace-header/compact-actions v0.2 -> staging at 2026-03-25T02:30:00Z :rocket:
